obligations.expected_behavior: For the complete current Consumer Manifest, establish a repository-caller mapping covering VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing, with every manifest consumer accounted for by the corresponding repository caller set.
forbidden_result: Any Consumer Manifest consumer in VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing lacks a corresponding repository caller.
Reconciliation covers only a subset of the complete current Consumer Manifest.
obligations.observable_result: A reconciliation result shows that every in-scope Consumer Manifest consumer has a corresponding repository caller across VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing.
obligations.state_after: Every consumer declared in the complete current Consumer Manifest is accounted for in the repository callers for VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing.
obligations.state_before: The complete current Consumer Manifest and repository callers for VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing are in scope; reconciliation outcome is not yet established.
obligations.subject: Consumer Manifest to repository-caller coverage
obligations.trigger: When reconciling the complete current Consumer Manifest with repository callers.

obligations.expected_behavior: Establish a reverse repository-caller mapping covering VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing, with every in-scope repository caller represented in the complete current Consumer Manifest.
forbidden_result: Any repository caller in VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing is absent from the Consumer Manifest.
Reconciliation is one-way or omits repository callers from the reverse check.
obligations.observable_result: A reconciliation result shows that every in-scope repository caller has a corresponding entry in the complete current Consumer Manifest across VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing.
obligations.state_after: Every repository caller in VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing is represented in the complete current Consumer Manifest.
obligations.state_before: The complete current Consumer Manifest and repository callers for VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing are in scope; reconciliation outcome is not yet established.
obligations.subject: Repository-caller to Consumer Manifest coverage
obligations.trigger: When reconciling repository callers against the complete current Consumer Manifest.
